name: hybrid
rationale: M5-04 sixth cost candidate (record 119 §5), restated on top of the released retrieval bundle (policy 3361ed13): only the answer-context layout changes, off -> sentfocus-v8 = sentfocus-v7 without the rule line: the legend still names each evidence document (title cut at a word boundary within 90 characters, version) but gives no instruction. Why: v7's rule line made ss-0088 abstain again and removed every safety blocker, but it also made the model abstain on five items that v2 and v6 answered and did not stop ss-0090 / ss-0096; v8 tests whether the information alone is enough. Cost gate: tokens per main item <= 75% of baseline, overall success drop <= 1 pp, slice and safety rules unchanged.
